name: INGeo
definition: A method that accelerates 3D scene reconstruction training by leveraging noisy geometry priors (e.g., from RGB-D sensors or COLMAP) converted into an occupancy grid, aiming for instant reconstruction on edge devices.
summary: INGeo accelerates 3D reconstruction on edge devices by initializing Instant-NGP with noisy geometry priors and applying density scaling to ensure rapid surface convergence.
